title: Static holding torque of a single arm link
assumptions: uniform bar: the arm's own mass acts at its middle
payload is a point mass at the tip
extra masses may sit beyond the arm's end
angle measured from horizontal: 0 degrees is level, 90 degrees is straight up
a torque rating is used only when the learner supplies one from a datasheet, and says whether it is a stall or continuous rating
gravity is standard gravity, 9.80665 m/s²; only textbook checks state another value

worked_examples.location: §9.6 Forces and Torques in Muscles and Joints, Example 9.4 (horizontal forearm, its own weight included)
§12.2 Examples of Static Equilibrium, Example 12.4 (forearm at 60° to the vertical, its weight neglected; checked on the payload share)
packages/solvers/src/staticTorque.test.ts: tilted servo arm at 30° from horizontal (hand derivation, not textbook)
